dct_alternative_sm: Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean (Puerto Rico and U.S. Virgin Islands) offshore surficial-sediment data release
dct_description_sm: "This report provides a synthesis compilation of published and unpublished sediment texture and other geologic data about the seafloor from diverse sources ... Examples of maps displaying attributes such as grain size and sediment color"--CD-ROM container insert.
Also available via Internet from the USGS web site. Address as of 12/1/106: http://store.usgs.gov/sap/its/y_images/PDF/206911.pdf; current access via PURL.
Contributors: Buczkowski, Brian J.; Geological Survey (U.S.)
Publication statement: Menlo Park, Calif. : U.S. Dept. of the Interior, U.S. Geological Survey, 2006.
Relief shown by contours, shading, gradient tints and landforms.
System requirements: PC with Internet access, Adobe Reader, GIS software; CD-ROM drive.
gbl_displayNote_sm: Based on LOC maps search metadata, including embedded catalog fields. Full item enrichment and collection reconciliation remain pending.
